page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, full width. Printed page number at top right, running head at top centre. Catchword at the lower right and a signature mark at the foot centre. No marginal notes.

p.i: tium: libertatem vero habentibus opus esse custodiá. custodiam optimam esse concordiam: ei locum futurum, si genitrix & altrix discordiae avaritia cum luxu profligata fuerit: ubi enim sobrietas, & frugi vita universè apud omnes valent, illic nec invidentia, nec odio, nec injuriis aut contumeliis mutuis locum esse: idcirco, ut ad vitam hujusmodi more populi traduceret, legislatorem consilia sua praecipue retulisse: jussisse enim pueros in coetus, quos ἀγέλας dicebant, itare, adultos vero in sysitia, a viris ἀν-δρεία nuncupata, in quibus pauperes cum divitibus indifferenter cibu isdem vescerentur: voluisse assuefieri eos a teneris ad arma & labores, ad tolerandum frigus & aestum, ad calcandas acclives asperasque vias, ad expediendos inferendosque ictus in gymnasiis, & pugnis solennibus, ad sagittas jaciendas, ad saltationes armatas in Creta primum a Curete reperta, ut ne ludi quidem expertes essent in, qua ad bellum facerent, ad cantum praeterea militarem, ad vestes & calceos militiae accommodos, aliaque hujusmodi. Sic, ut dixi, Strabo ex Ephoro. Legislatorem hunc Minoa accipio, qui ab omnibus veteribus creditur leges Cretensibus tulisse: in quorum numero est etiam

page.notes: The Greek words ἀγέλας and ἀν-δρεία are transcribed from the scan; the accents on ἀγέλας and the first syllable of ἀνδρεία are hard to make out and should be checked. The word "sobrietas" may be printed with an initial long-s form and is read as "sobrietas". "custodiá" and "cibu" are read as printed; "cibu" may be a printing error for "cibum". The headline "REIP. CRETENSIVM." is set in small capitals. The fragments at the left edge and the faint text at the bottom right are show-through or the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.
